name: Ampere cp.async multistage GEMM mainloop
summary: Pipeline global-to-shared copies through cp.async while warp-level MMA consumes earlier shared-memory stages, using commit and wait groups to overlap memory movement with computation.

strategy.intent: Hide global-memory latency behind Ampere Tensor Core computation.
strategy.mechanism: Issue predicated or zero-filled asynchronous copies for A and B, commit groups at stage boundaries, wait before reuse, and rotate through shared-memory stages.
strategy.expected_benefit: Overlaps data movement and MMA without dedicating separate producer warps.
tradeoffs: Requires at least two shared-memory stages.
Copy access width, alignment, predication, and wait distance must be coordinated correctly.

constraints.rationale: MmaMultistage identifies Sm80 as the minimum architecture for cp.async.
The collective specialization requires a multistage pipeline.
cp.async access sizes and cache modes impose alignment requirements.
Consumers must not read incomplete copies or overwrite in-flight stages.

references.evidence: The class exposes stage count, cache operations, async-copy iteration groups, and Sm80 as the minimum architecture.
The architecture helpers emit cp.async commit-group and wait-group synchronization instructions.
